content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The COREMERCH solution stands out by providing a complete infrastructure for digital creators that is not only readily deployable but also highly customizable. The Sovereign Starter Stack gives you a straightforward setup with GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while the Edge Commerce Stack offers an advanced configuration with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. Each option is priced competitively, with the Sovereign Starter Stack at $97 and the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Unlike conventional platforms, these stacks empower creators to fully control their storefront code, customer data, and transaction histories, ensuring that nothing is locked behind a paywall or subject to arbitrary freezes.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

In regions where payment platforms impose restrictions, the COREMERCH stacks operate without geographic limitations. The use of NOWPayments allows for payment processing in over 300 cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for KYC requirements and protecting creators from account suspensions. This is crucial in countries like Zimbabwe and Ethiopia, where traditional payment platforms have failed. By focusing on infrastructure sovereignty, COREMERCH enables creators to transact freely, leveraging blockchain technology to bypass conventional banking limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When comparing payment processing speeds and fees, COREMERCH offers a distinct advantage over traditional payment systems. With a 0.5% fee for NOWPayments, transaction costs remain low, especially when using optimized networks like BSC and Solana, where costs are typically under $0.10 per transaction. In contrast, platforms like Stripe and PayPal often impose higher fees alongside withdrawal delays, which can extend up to several days. COREMERCH ensures that payment confirmations occur instantly via on-chain verification, providing immediate transaction outcomes for creators.
Own your code, own your customers, own your success.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital commerce infrastructure is paramount for creators. With COREMERCH, after deployment, creators possess their storefront code, customer lists, and order histories outright—no subscriptions or ongoing fees involved. The automated delivery of products using tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that customers can access their purchases immediately after payment confirmation. In contrast, conventional platforms often retain control over user data and can suspend accounts without notice, adding unnecessary risk to creator businesses.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on the scale and specific needs of your digital business. For creators just starting out, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a cost-effective way to establish an online presence quickly. If you’re looking for a more robust solution with additional features, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal, providing enhanced scalability and functionality. Evaluate your product offerings and customer base to select the best stack, and consider the Complete Builder Kit for comprehensive resources and templates to streamline your deployment.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The question of whether to build on platforms or build sovereign infrastructure comes down to a single risk calculation: what happens when the platform changes its terms, restricts your market, or suspends your account? For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other restricted markets, that question has already been answered — the platform already said no. Sovereign infrastructure is the primary architecture for creators who cannot afford to depend on platforms that have already demonstrated they will exclude your market without notice, without recourse, and without apology.
No more account freezes—operate freely in the digital marketplace.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators looking to enhance their sovereignty in the digital marketplace, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 essential templates, providing everything needed to quickly build and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Audit your current infrastructure dependencies before building the sovereign stack — list every platform account your income depends on and identify the failure mode for each. For each platform that holds funds or controls access to customers, build the sovereign alternative in parallel before migrating. Start with the payment layer: NOWPayments configured with your self-custody wallet addresses. Then the backend: Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script handling webhook receipt and order processing. Then the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serving your product pages. Then the data layer: Supabase or Google Sheets storing every order independently of any payment platform. Test the complete pipeline on mainnet. Migrate your audience to the sovereign store gradually.
Frequently Asked Questions
What does owning my store infrastructure mean?

Owning your store infrastructure means you retain complete control over your code, customer data, and transaction history. This eliminates dependency on third-party platforms and protects you from arbitrary account restrictions.
How does COREMERCH handle payment processing?

COREMERCH uses NOWPayments to process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring low fees and immediate transaction confirmations without KYC requirements, making it ideal for creators in restricted regions.
Are there any ongoing fees after deployment?
No, once your COREMERCH stack is deployed, there are no ongoing fees. You pay a one-time fee for the setup, ensuring long-term cost predictability and financial freedom.
What if I need support after launch?
COREMERCH provides 30-day support following deployment, ensuring you have the help needed to troubleshoot and optimize your store for success.
Can I scale my store as I grow?
Absolutely. COREMERCH stacks are designed for scalability, allowing you to add more products and features as your business expands without losing ownership or control.
Scale without limits; your infrastructure, your rules.
